description: This file contains functions for user management within the TestLink open source testing platform. It includes functions to set user sessions, retrieve users for HTML options, build user maps, reset passwords, get user roles, and manage user grants, among others.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the testing platform, providing methods for user data management and validation.

methods.name: setUserSession
methods.description: Sets session data after user modification or authorization, including handling cookies and default test project ID.

methods.name: getUsersForHtmlOptions
methods.description: Returns a map of users suitable for populating an HTML select element, with optional filters.

methods.name: buildUserMap
methods.description: Builds a map of user display names, optionally including inactive users and additional options for HTML select inputs.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets a user's password in the database, optionally emailing or displaying the new password.

methods.name: getUserErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts a status code into a human-readable error message related to user operations.

methods.name: getAllUsersRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all users with their roles, optionally ordered by a specified field.

methods.name: getTestersForHtmlOptions
methods.description: Returns users with rights to execute test cases in a given test plan and project, formatted for HTML options.

methods.name: initialize_tabsmenu
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object representing the tabs permissions menu for user interfaces.

methods.name: getGrantsForUserMgmt
methods.description: Determines and returns the grant privileges for user and role management, based on current user rights and context.

methods.name: setUserSessionFromObj
methods.description: Wrapper function that sets user session data from a user object.
